description: Inbound and outbound public IP addresses of the dis-core and dis-edge AKS clusters, per environment. Read from Azure Resource Graph across the dis-core-test, dis-core-staging and dis-core-prod subscriptions.

panels.description: Public addresses of the dis-core AKS clusters, one row per environment. Inbound: the cluster load balancer's public IP. Outbound: the public IP prefix the cluster's traffic leaves from; allow-list this range when a remote service filters on source IP. "—" means the environment has no such address.

azureResourceGraph.query:
Resources
| where type in ("microsoft.network/publicipaddresses", "microsoft.network/publicipprefixes")
| where name matches regex @"^dis-core-[a-z0-9]+-aks-(pip|prefix)[46]$"
| extend Env = extract(@"^dis-[a-z]+-([a-z0-9]+)-aks-", 1, name),
         Kind = extract(@"-aks-(pip|prefix)[46]$", 1, name),
         Ver = extract(@"([46])$", 1, name)
| extend Address = iff(Kind == "pip", tostring(properties.ipAddress), tostring(properties.ipPrefix))
| summarize
    ['Inbound IPv4'] = take_anyif(Address, Kind == "pip" and Ver == "4"),
    ['Inbound IPv6'] = take_anyif(Address, Kind == "pip" and Ver == "6"),
    ['Outbound IPv4'] = take_anyif(Address, Kind == "prefix" and Ver == "4"),
    ['Outbound IPv6'] = take_anyif(Address, Kind == "prefix" and Ver == "6")
    by Env
| extend Order = case(Env == "at22", 1, Env == "at23", 2, Env == "at24", 3, Env == "yt01", 4, Env == "tt02", 5, Env == "prod", 6, 9)
| order by Order asc
| project Environment = toupper(Env), ['Inbound IPv4'], ['Inbound IPv6'], ['Outbound IPv4'], ['Outbound IPv6']

panels.title: DIS Core
